notes: 短视频解说多语言叶子。

craft.sentence: 一句一意；逗号可换气；避免超长定语
craft.avoid: 书面倒装、难读英文堆砌、表情包文字

referenceParagraph.zh: 今天关注一项新规。它影响三类人：从业者、平台，还有普通用户。我们用三分钟说清变化。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 今天关注一项新规。它影响三类人：从业者、平台，还有普通用户。我们用三分钟说清变化。
referenceParagraph.en: Today’s focus is a new rule. It hits three groups: workers, platforms, and users. Three minutes to make the change clear.
referenceParagraph.ja: Today’s focus is a new rule. It hits three groups: workers, platforms, and users. Three minutes to make the change clear.

craft.sentence: 口语连接词；悬念句可独立成段
craft.stance: 讲述感，不装纪录片旁白
craft.avoid: 书面成语堆、复杂括号注释
craft.lexicon: 你听、后来、没想到、停一下

referenceParagraph.zh: 故事从一个拒绝开始。她挂断电话的时候，以为只是丢了一单——后来才知道丢的是一整条路。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 故事从一个拒绝开始。她挂断电话的时候，以为只是丢了一单——后来才知道丢的是一整条路。
referenceParagraph.en: It starts with a no. When she hung up, she thought she’d lost one job—later she learned she’d lost a whole road.
referenceParagraph.ja: It starts with a no. When she hung up, she thought she’d lost one job—later she learned she’d lost a whole road.

craft.opening: 听众以为自己懂的一点
craft.lexicon: 简单说、比如、别误会、记住

referenceParagraph.zh: 别先背定义。你去菜场觉得贵，不一定是「通胀」三个字能概括——我们拆成价格、预期和替代品。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 别先背定义。你去菜场觉得贵，不一定是「通胀」三个字能概括——我们拆成价格、预期和替代品。
referenceParagraph.en: Don’t start with the textbook. Feeling prices at the market isn’t just “inflation”—we’ll split price, expectation, and substitutes.
referenceParagraph.ja: Don’t start with the textbook. Feeling prices at the market isn’t just “inflation”—we’ll split price, expectation, and substitutes.

craft.sentence: 第二人称多；语气词可控

referenceParagraph.zh: 你是不是也刷到那条热搜了？别急着站队。我们先把时间线捋直，再决定气什么。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 你是不是也刷到那条热搜了？别急着站队。我们先把时间线捋直，再决定气什么。
referenceParagraph.en: Did you see that trending post too? Don’t pick a side yet. We’ll straighten the timeline—then decide what to be mad at.
referenceParagraph.ja: Did you see that trending post too? Don’t pick a side yet. We’ll straighten the timeline—then decide what to be mad at.

referenceParagraph.zh: 今天關注一項新規。它影響三類人。我們用三分鐘說清變化。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 今天關注一項新規，三分鐘說清。
referenceParagraph.en: Today’s focus is a new rule. It hits three groups. Three minutes to make the change clear.
referenceParagraph.ja: 今日の焦点は新ルール。三分で変化を言う。

craft.opening: 聽眾以為自己懂的一點
